headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 25, 2026**
article:
The Colorado Rockies secured a 5-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Tomoyuki Sugano earning the win after 5.1 innings of work. Brice Turang led the Brewers' offense with 3 hits, including a home run. The Kansas City Royals dropped a 1-2 decision to the Detroit Tigers, unable to overcome a strong outing from Tarik Skubal. Skubal earned the win with 7.1 innings pitched, 12 strikeouts, and just 1 earned run.

Several players have been affected by injuries, impacting their team's availability. Rafael Flores Jr. has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion, with the move retroactive to July 23, 2026. The Philadelphia Phillies have also made several roster moves, including transferring RHP Brad Keller to the 60-day injured list due to a right elbow UCL tear and placing C Rafael Marchán on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 23, 2026, due to left knee patellar tendinitis.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, including the Kansas City Royals trading CF Kameron Misner to the Philadelphia Phillies for cash and the Pittsburgh Pirates acquiring RHP Ron Marinaccio from the San Diego Padres for Future Considerations.
